t1.descripcion:
Direct object pronouns answer the question "¿qué?" or "¿a quién?".

🔹 DO PRONOUNS:

| Person | Pronoun | Example |
|---------|-----------|---------|
| yo | me | Me ves (tú me ves a mí) |
| tú | te | Te veo (yo te veo a ti) |
| él/ella/usted | lo / la | Lo veo (a él) / La veo (a ella) |
| nosotros | nos | Nos ven (ellos nos ven) |
| vosotros | os | Os veo (yo os veo) |
| ellos/ellas/ustedes | los / las | Los veo (a ellos) / Las veo (a ellas) |

🔹 IMPORTANT RULES:
• "Lo" is used for masculine singular nouns
• "La" is used for feminine singular nouns
• "Los" is used for masculine plural nouns
• "Las" is used for feminine plural nouns

🔹 EXAMPLES:
• Veo el coche → Lo veo.
• Como la manzana → La como.
• Leo los libros → Los leo.
• Compro las manzanas → Las compro.
• Conozco a María → La conozco.
• Conozco a Pedro → Lo conozco.

📌 POSITION:
DO pronouns are placed BEFORE the conjugated verb:
• Lo veo (correct)
• Veolo (incorrect)

❌ COMMON MISTAKE:
Do not confuse "lo" (direct object) with "le" (indirect object).

t2.descripcion:
Indirect object pronouns answer the question "¿a quién?" or "¿para quién?".

🔹 IO PRONOUNS:

| Person | Pronoun | Example |
|---------|-----------|---------|
| yo | me | Me da el libro (él me da el libro a mí) |
| tú | te | Te doy el regalo (yo te doy el regalo a ti) |
| él/ella/usted | le | Le doy el libro (a él/ella/usted) |
| nosotros | nos | Nos dan la información (a nosotros) |
| vosotros | os | Os compro un regalo (a vosotros) |
| ellos/ellas/ustedes | les | Les envío un mensaje (a ellos/ellas/ustedes) |

🔹 EXAMPLES:
• Doy el libro a María → Le doy el libro.
• Envío un mensaje a ellos → Les envío un mensaje.
• Compro un regalo para ti → Te compro un regalo.
• Presto dinero a Juan → Le presto dinero.

📌 DIFFERENCE BETWEEN DO AND IO:
• DO answers "¿qué?" or "¿a quién?" (directly)
• IO answers "¿a quién?" or "¿para quién?" (indirectly)

Example:
• Doy el libro (OD: el libro) a María (OI: a María)

❌ COMMON MISTAKE:
Do not confuse "le" (singular IO) with "les" (plural IO) or "lo/la" (DO).
ejemplos: Digo la verdad a Juan → Le digo la verdad.

t3.descripcion:
When we use DO and IO together:

🔹 RULES:
1. The IO goes FIRST, then the DO.
2. "le" and "les" change to "SE" before "lo/la/los/las".

📌 STRUCTURE: IO + DO + verb

🔹 EXAMPLES:
• Doy el libro a María → Se lo doy.
  (le + lo → se lo)

• Envío la carta a Juan → Se la envío.
  (le + la → se la)

• Compro los regalos para los niños → Se los compro.
  (les + los → se los)

• Vendo las flores a mi madre → Se las vendo.
  (le + las → se las)

🔹 COMBINATION TABLE:

| IO + DO | Result | Example |
|---------|-----------|---------|
| le + lo | se lo | Se lo doy |
| le + la | se la | Se la envío |
| le + los | se los | Se los compro |
| le + las | se las | Se las vendo |
| les + lo | se lo | Se lo digo a ellos |
| les + la | se la | Se la mando |
| les + los | se los | Se los regalo |
| les + las | se las | Se las presto |

📌 COMPLETE EXAMPLES:
• ¿Tienes el libro? → Sí, se lo doy a María.
• ¿Tienes la carta? → Sí, se la envío a Juan.
• ¿Tienes los regalos? → Sí, se los compro a los niños.

❌ COMMON ERROR:
Don't say "le lo doy". Always change to "se lo doy".
ejemplos: ¿Tienes el libro? → Sí, se lo doy a María.
¿Me prestas el dinero? → Sí, te lo presto.

t4.descripcion:
Pronouns can go in different positions depending on the type of verb:

🔹 1. WITH CONJUGATED VERBS (present, past, etc.):
• Pronouns go BEFORE the verb.

Examples:
• Lo veo. (I see it)
• Te quiero. (I love you)
• Se lo dije. (I told him/her)
• Me lo compró. (He bought it for me)

🔹 2. WITH INFINITIVES (verbs ending in -ar, -er, -ir):
• Pronouns ATTACH to the end of the infinitive.

Examples:
• Voy a comprarlo. (I'm going to buy it)
• Quiero verte. (I want to see you)
• Puedo hacerlo. (I can do it)
• Necesito decírtelo. (I need to tell you it)

🔹 3. WITH GERUNDS (-ando, -iendo):
• Pronouns ATTACH to the end of the gerund.

Examples:
• Estoy comprándolo. (I'm buying it)
• Está haciéndolo. (He/She is doing it)
• Estaban mirándonos. (They were watching us)

🔹 4. WITH AFFIRMATIVE IMPERATIVES (commands):
• Pronouns ATTACH to the end of the imperative.

Examples:
• Cómpramelo. (Buy it for me)
• Dime la verdad. (Tell me the truth)
• Hazlo ahora. (Do it now)

🔹 5. WITH NEGATIVE IMPERATIVES:
• Pronouns go BEFORE the verb.

Examples:
• No me lo compres. (Don't buy it for me)
• No me digas eso. (Don't tell me that)
• No lo hagas. (Don't do it)

📌 SUMMARY TABLE:

| Type of verb | Position | Example |
|---------------|----------|---------|
| Conjugated | Before | Lo veo |
| Infinitive | Attached to the end | Verlo |
| Gerund | Attached to the end | Viéndolo |
| Affirmative imperative | Attached to the end | Cómpramelo |
| Negative imperative | Before | No me lo compres |

❌ COMMON MISTAKE:
Don't say "lo voy a ver" when you want to say "Voy a verlo". Both are correct, but the second is more natural in Spain.

dict.昨天是我妹妹安娜的生日。我想给她买一份特别的礼物。我去了一家服装店，看到一条非常: Yesterday was my sister Ana's birthday. I wanted to buy her a special gift. I went to a clothing store and saw a very pretty skirt. The shop assistant showed it to me and said: “This is the last one.” I bought it for Ana. I also bought a T-shirt for my brother. I gave it to my mother to wrap. In the evening at the party, I gave the gifts to Ana. She opened it and loved it. My parents gave money to me and my siblings. They gave it to us to buy books. We were all happy.
dict.叙述者为安娜买了什么？: What did the narrator buy for Ana?
dict.文中说“vi una falda muy bonita”并“la compré: The text says “vi una falda muy bonita” and “la compré para Ana”, so it's a skirt.
dict.文中说“Se la di a mi madre para que la envo: The text says “Se la di a mi madre para que la envolviera”, that is, gave the gift to her mother to wrap.
dict.父母给了兄弟姐妹什么？: What did the parents give the siblings?
dict.文中说“Mis padres nos dieron dinero”，即父母给了他: The text says “Mis padres nos dieron dinero”, that is, the parents gave them money.
dict.安娜打开礼物时反应如何？: How did Ana react when she opened the gift?
dict.文中说“Ella lo abrió y le encantó”，即她打开后非常喜: The text says “Ella lo abrió y le encantó”, that is, she opened it and loved it.
dict.在西班牙，生日和圣诞节有送礼物的习俗。当别人给你礼物时，你应该当场打开并表示感谢: In Spain, it is customary to give gifts on birthdays and at Christmas. When someone gives you a gift, you should open it right away and thank them. Usually small, meaningful gifts are given, such as books, scarves or handmade items. People also often give money in an envelope to children, especially at Christmas or First Communion.
dict.在中国，人们收到礼物时通常不会当场打开，而是等客人离开后再看，以避免显得贪心。而: In China, people usually don't open gifts right away when they receive them, but wait until the guests leave to look at them, to avoid seeming greedy. In Spain, opening gifts right away and thanking the giver is a sign of politeness.
